caption:
Your inbox now sorts itself. Free, built into Gmail.

1. Search a sender or keyword, then open the filter options in the search box
2. Click Create filter
3. Tick: Skip the Inbox, Apply the label, Mark as read
4. Save. Every matching email now files itself

Start with newsletters and receipts.

sub: Free. Google Apps Script. No app to install.
trigger: Every hour a script wakes up
caption:
Attachments file themselves. Free with Google Apps Script.

A small script runs every hour, finds new emails with attachments, saves each file to a Drive folder and labels the email so it is never saved twice.

Where to start: script.google.com → New project → add a time-driven trigger.

Invoices now enter themselves. Free with Gmail, Sheets and Apps Script.

A script checks Gmail every hour, finds new invoice emails, reads the vendor, date and amount, adds a row to your Sheet and labels the email as logged.

Where to start: create a Sheet → Extensions → Apps Script → add a time-driven trigger.

caption:
Out of office, set once. Free, built into Gmail.

1. Settings → See all settings
2. General → scroll to Vacation responder
3. Turn it on, write your message, pick the dates
4. Save Changes

Tip: tick the box to send replies only to your contacts.
